title: Luanes Magical World
desc: Luane’s Magical World, an enchanting fantasy destination in the sky of Le Monde Perdu, awaits with a lot of magic for you to discover! From breathtaking scenes perfect for photography to quiet, romantic corners, there’s a sense of wonder everywhere you look. Whether you’re here to explore, take photos, or simply enjoy a peaceful moment alone or with someone special, you’re very welcome.

title: Storybook
desc: Welcome to Storybook, a fairytale forest dedicated to your childhood bedtime stories. Find your favorite fairytales, take pictures and explore!

title: Prehistorica, the Dawn Kingdoms
desc: Journey to an age when dinosaurs walked the earth and dragons ruled the skies.  Plunge into this time travel experience or battle invading elementals in the floating temple of Azhar Dracys. Explore the primordial jungles, smoldering volcanos, and sunlit seas of a forgotten world. Encounter its majestic and deadly denizens, take one home as an Animesh companion, or become one yourself and experience SL as never before in the form of one of our dozens of awe-inspiring dinosaur and mighty dragon Avatars!

title: SHADOWFELL V
desc: The mists have lifted once again on SHADOWFELL! Now in its 5th year, creators Ty Tenk and Truck Meredith continue to update, enhance, and add to this ever-evolving world of beauty, horror, and magic. Explore 4 immersive regions by Elven Boat or The Elven Flyer, or venture into Caverns, Forbidden Forests, Swamps, and Ancient Elven Ruins—or attend live music at the Shadowfell Pavilion. The journey continues…

title: SHADOWFELL PAVILION
desc: Nestled within the stunning and magical Elven Gardens of Shadowfell, the SHADOWFELL PAVILION offers music, dancing, and romance throughout October. Enjoy Calas Galadhon Live Music events featuring some of SL’s finest talent, or come anytime and dance beneath Shadowfell’s two moons to a 24/7 music stream. Come for the music, stay for the magic!

title: The John King Experience
desc: Discover the story behind the youngest pirate ever recorded in history! Clicking the scroll will magically transport you into the story of little John King, told with traditional illustrations and audio. A wonderful little experience for all fans of pirates, adventure and something a little different.

title: The Faery Crossing
desc: Have you ever wanted to dance with the Fae in the pale moonlight? Do you want to wander magical lands filled with mysteries and hidden nooks and crannies? Do you want to walk in serene and quiet nature or see the Fae perform ancient rituals? Then come to one of the oldest Fae lands in Second Life: The Faery Crossing. Here you will find beautiful lands, wonderful people, and serenity and whimsy alike, with activities like dances, Bardic Circles, druidic rituals, and guides tours on horseback. Go Betwixt and Between and visit now!

title: Lost Unicorn
desc: A dreamy, beautiful and mystical Elven realm shrouded in mist and magic. The forest is home to fairies, centaurs, unicorns, and much abundant wildlife. Grab your loved ones for a stroll, explore to your heart's content, or bring your camera to take stunning pictures. The numerous hidden spots are also perfect for relaxing. Can you find them all?

title: Inspire Space Park
desc: Come be a part of the wonderful community at Inspire Space Park, running since 2007! Meditate in a cosmic sci-fi natural outer space galaxy built by talented SL artists. Blast off into the heavens, a universe of magic! Float amidst the stars and planets, and listen to soothing ambient tunes. They embrace everyone and value each of their visitors and many make a permanent home here. Affordable land rentals and moon base homes too!

title: Dandelion DayDreams Factory
desc:
You are invited to visit and enjoy Dandelion DayDreams Factory! Feel free to stroll about, bring your friends, have a good time!
They offer seasonal events, such as contests, hunts, and the changing Quest Adventure games installed for your entertainment.

title: Oddly Japan
desc: Oddly Japan’s Rain Village is a living echo of a world inspired by Naruto, but it tells its own story. The rain never quite stops here. It gathers on steel rooftops, drips from cables strung between towering structures, and reflects a skyline shaped by conflict and survival. Neon glows through mist. Paper lanterns flicker against cold metal. It feels like a hidden village that endured too much and refused to fall. It’s built to be seen. Every corner is photographic, every angle a frame. Wander the alleys, cross the high walkways, watch the rain from above, or just exist here with friends. A train cuts through the silence. Shops hum quietly. Beneath it all, something pulses in the dark.

title: Wonderland 2.0
desc: Go down the rabbit hole and find yourself in Alice's abandoned park. Adult cuddles, unicorns, the Hatter's house, caves, pirate ships, and magic is everywhere. Try not to get lost in Wonderland 2.0.

title: SHADOWFELL'S CIRCLE OF LIGHT
desc: Beyond the ruins of the ancient Elven city lies a meadow where the last light of magic still battles the darkness. At its heart, the Circle of Light glows upon enchanted waters, holding the darkness at bay. Relax among plentiful seating, enjoy quiet moments alone, or cuddle with someone special. Experience music, choreographed dance events and spectacular particle light shows beneath Shadowfell’s magic.

title: The Cursed Coast
desc: Enter The Cursed Coast, a mysterious pirate island filled with hidden caves, forgotten ruins, shipwrecks, jungle paths and a sinister voodoo swamp. Meet strange inhabitants, uncover clues, solve puzzles and search for rare objects scattered across the island. Explore carefully — some secrets were buried for a reason.

title: Death Valley
desc: Inspired by California’s Death Valley, this dystopian fantasy destination features Panamint Ghost Town, charcoal kilns, and other recognizable desert locations. Visitors can explore a harsh post-apocalyptic landscape filled with abandoned structures and hidden dangers.

title: The Emerald Vale
desc: Step into The Emerald Vale, an immersive retelling of L. Frank Baum's The Wonderful Wizard of Oz. Journey from Kansas to the Emerald City as you follow Dorothy's adventure through interactive scenes, a guided Story HUD, and memorable moments inspired by the classic novel. Explore at your own pace, uncover hidden details, and experience the magic of Oz.

title: LOST
desc: Step into a fractured future shaped by secrets and silence. LOST is an immersive dystopian island designed for exploration and cinematic photography.

title: Lawst Paradise
desc: Explore Lawst Paradise, a captivating blend of old world charm, pirates, steampunk, and enchanting magic! Step through the grand entrance of Lawst Castle, where a labyrinth of caves awaits to whisk you deep into the heart of the region. Discover fabulous features like the Lawst Paradise Art Gallery, floating cottages at Lawst Paradise Rentals, and delightful Breedable Pets. Keep yer senses sharp as ye navigate through thrilling games, captivating entertainment, spine-tingling hauntings, majestic dragons, and fearsome man-eating plants. Seek hidden treasures, explore a sunken pirate ship, and behold the ancient whales that grace our waters, plus a bounty of wonders awaits ye! Set sail for adventure!

title: Dystopian Night
desc: Come and soak up the atmosphere of this near-future dystopian and cyberpunk sprawl. Take photos, hang with friends, explore, roleplay, or just chill out in this cityscape.

title: Lunamere
desc: Lunamere is a five-region modern-fantasy estate for community, exploration, creativity, and photography. Visitors can enjoy social events or wander enchanted woodlands, shadowed coasts, floating islands, hidden sanctuaries, and the overgrown town of Lumora, where old magic hums beneath modern life. Above all, Lunamere is a proud haven for LGBTQIA+ adults and allies.

title: DragonMyst
desc: DragonMyst is the home of Fairelands Thunder, an official dragon group of Fantasy Faire. It is also the home of Elf Clan, SL's oldest large fantasy group. It is a totally interactive 'visitor' region themed for both dragons (of all sizes) and their smaller friends (elves, fae, and even humans). A "family-friendly" region that is great fun to explore with a friend or two.

title: Egypt: The Forgotten Pharaoh
desc: Descend into a haunted Egyptian pyramid, filled with walking mummies, eerie Anubis mummification scenes, towering guardian statues, and a mysterious sarcophagus waiting deep within its ancient, shadowy chambers.

title: Havenwood - This is Halloween
desc: A cold wind shifts and the leaves begin to fall! Spooky season rises as monsters creep and ghouls moan. Darkest fears begin to unfold! Halloween is drawing near, and in Havenwood it has appeared! Visitors are welcome, but be not afraid; many surprises are underway!

title: Paradise Of Fantasy
desc: Nature meets fantasy in this home for the "Vanaheim Family" and all fantasy creatures. This magical place is where fantasy creatures stand strong together in light and darkness.

title: Sable Hound Hollow
desc: Sable Hound Hollow is for those who dare to dream. From the mushrooms that tower overhead to the islands above suspended in quiet defiance of gravity, this fae-touched land invites you to wander freely. Step in and see what you find, or what finds you.

title: Storywood Sanctuary
desc: In the heart of an ancient forest, where sunlight filtered through the dense canopy in dappled patterns, lay the Storywood Sanctuary. This magical haven was a place where stories came alive, and the trees whispered tales of old to those who would listen. Now, you're invited to wander through lush landscapes, dream under the shade of ancient trees, and savor a freshly brewed coffee. Whether you're in the mood to lose yourself in a captivating tale or simply relax in the tranquil surroundings, Storywood Sanctuary is the perfect place to do it. Enjoy the magic of this haven, where every corner holds a story waiting to be discovered.

title: AS Eleven Fairy Waterfalls Land
desc: Lose yourself in this magical fairy waterfalls garden that is full of adventure and fantasy. It's the perfect place to do Taï Chï, take pictures, meditate, sleep in a giant flower, and chat with new friends.

title: Viper Isles - An Elysian Paradise
desc: Lose yourself in a realm where fantasy and realism entwine. Wander through lush valleys, sparkling ponds, and ancient ruins, or soar to floating islands above the clouds. From mystical waterfalls and dragon lairs to romantic retreats and underwater realms, Viper Isles offers beauty, mystery, and adventure at every turn. Explore, photograph, or escape into a world crafted to inspire wonder.

title: The Outer Garden
desc: The Outer Garden is a place where love is hiding. The landing point is filled with happiness where the romantic atmosphere and pale lights surround you, which would make your time with friends and lovers special. Click the mirror at the landing point to teleport to other gardens, where you can enjoy walking and taking pictures. Go on an adventure at this magical fantasy destination.

title: The Elvenwood
desc: Wander amongst the trees and be surprised at the delights of the Fairytale Forest (can you find the hidden treasure chest?) Discover the Ballroom of the Mermaids and walk with trepidation through the Dark Wood. Travel to distant Asia to the island of Enoshima or back in time to the classical world of Delfai (and have your prophecy read by the Oracle). And mostly come for peace and tranquility.

title: Land of Fantasy
desc: A little park where you can find some peace and be one with nature with a hint of fantasy. Walk the roads and explore!

title: Fairywood Fete
desc: Wander into Fairywood Fête at Stardust Hallow, an enchanted forest filled with towering mushrooms, curious creatures, hidden paths and magical secrets waiting to be discovered. Join the fête September 19th sponsored by Raindale & Sekai and explore the Fairywood Fête Market through October 19th. Come get lost in a little magic.

title: Nymerion at Akimori
desc: Dragons perch on the spires. Dinos stalk the glowing groves. Sharks circle a sunken cathedral. Nymerion is a region-wide fantasy world adapted from Elicio Ember's Otherworld, with two levels above ground and one under the sea. Hunt dragon eggs for prizes in Delain Canucci's quest, ride elven flyers, dance, cuddle, and try the shared sky-controller and paint the heavens yourself.

title: The Left Hand Path
desc: The Left Hand Path is a timeless, fantasy esoteric-themed destination that welcomes witches and wizards from all walks of life. Magic is for everyone! Feel free to take pictures, roleplay, romance, learn, and gather with friends. There are free rideable brooms! Best viewed with PBR, shared environment, and max draw distance.

title: Honey Swamp
desc: Honey Swamp is a whimsical fantasy brand filled with enchanted creatures, glowing honey sprites, and cozy swamp magic — blending storytelling, art, and collectible creations into a world where nature and imagination thrive together.

title: Kemet Island
desc: Kemet Island is an immersive and richly detailed fantasy world filled with enchanted gardens, magical forests, and soothing aquatic landscapes. Wander through waterfalls, hidden paths, and vibrant seasonal environments leading to secret hideaways. Discover meditation spaces, fairy-tale gardens, and dreamlike settings surrounded by nature and calming ambient sounds. From autumn forests in the rain to luminous floral worlds and peaceful oases, KEMET Island offers a magical escape dedicated to relaxation, exploration, and inspiration.

title: 2Chance World
desc: Step into the world of beloved characters and become part of their stories. Explore a living world that changes and evolves over time with stories — from the dark elegance of the Netherblooms, to Luca’s warm Italian sunshine, the magical nights of Alex & Sippy, and the cozy heart of Trucker Steve’s farm. Four unique worlds united in one immersive experience.

title: MoonWillow
desc: Welcome, traveler, to MoonWillow, a lush, mythical realm nestled deep within the folds of time, where magic lingers like mist in the morning air. Here, every leaf has a story, every shadow hides a spell, and every step draws you deeper.

title: Hotel Eranthe
desc: Hotel Eranthe is a beautiful land that does not exist in any place or time. Escape from the real world and lose yourself in the beauty of this fantasy resort that is open to everyone. You can enjoy mini golf, games, the theater, the spa, the dancing fountains, archery, quiet spots to enjoy the scenery, a restaurant, and so much more. Just come and explore!

title: Awenia Faerie
desc: Awenia is a Faery Tourist Trap. Bring the kids! Awenia boasts a crystal grove, a book forest, a sacred grove, beautiful photo opportunities, and many remembrances of Fantasy Faires past and recent. You'll find one-of-a-kind items such as The Last Hope statue, The Shrine Tree, and the Well of Whispers. Stay for a little while....stay forever.

title: Eds Universe
desc: Discover a destination from the depths of space to the moon and a fantastic underwater world. Use the many teleport options and travel through space with the spaceships. There is a lot to discover.... just have fun. Step through the gate....and the journey begins.

title: Malice in Wonderland
desc: Not quite Wonderland, the place perhaps where Alice gave into her Malice? This destination is a fantasy, sci-fi, post-apocalyptic, wonderland. Swim with mermaids, drink at the Cantina, and avoid the rains of the run-down streets. Secrets abound to explore.

title: Elven Forest
desc: Elven Forest is a mystical destination where elves, fae, and various mythical creatures gather. Visitors are encouraged to wear fantasy attire while exploring, relaxing, shopping, or enjoying light roleplay, including archery. All mythical beings and humans are welcome to join this enchanting community. Learn more at elvenforest.org

title: Quantum Groove
desc: As you wander through this dreamscape, ponder the question: "Do you control the dream? Or does the dream control you?" Welcome to a realm where reality and imagination intertwine, and every moment is a voyage into the extraordinary.

title: Pirates & Voodoo in the Bayou
desc: The adventure at Pirates & Voodoo in the Bayou begins with a soulless pirate guided boat ride winding its way through a dark and mysterious swamp to a secret voodoo-protected enclave for pirates notorious for the barbarous manner in which they conquer ships at sea. There you will find hidden valuable treasures and the exotic bounties they have plundered from the farthest corners of the world.

title: The Nightgarden
desc: Welcome to the Nightgarden, a mystical world of starlit serenity. Follow the paths, explore the phosphorescent flora, and bask in the waterfalls from the floating islands. Discover the portals that lead you to even more discoveries. And should you wade out into the lake, you might just find another whole underwater world awaiting you. Come relax, wander, and enjoy!

title: Morgana's Whispers
desc: Morgana's Whispers is a wonderous mystical beautiful nature scene with lots of discoveries for explorers. Also, a well-used area for photography in the forests or at the lake, rivers, and abundant flower-covered meadows.

title: Queen of the Nile
desc: Transport back to Ancient Egypt and roam the Great Pyramid like King Tut and Cleopatra. While here, explore the ancient underground tombs for an adventure like no other, but beware of hazardous snakes, ferocious lions, and the curse of the mummy. The Queen of the Nile is a magical oasis set on the harsh desert landscape, full of amazing photo spots, and cuddles for lovers.

title: Fantasy Weddings at Fairstone Quarry
desc: The fantasy wedding venue at Fairstone Quarry, located in the heart of the Bellisserian Fantasy realm, features seasonal bioluminescent lighting, the magical “Tree of Love” where you can hold your bonding ceremony, seating for your guests, an optional radio stream, and dance balls. To book your wedding and/or for more information please fill out the reservation form and contact Mischievious Mole. second.life/FantasyWeddingVenueReservation

title: Nightshade Academy
desc: Step beyond the gates of Nightshade Academy at Power Up Park, where magic, mystery, and imagination come alive. Explore an enchanted school nestled among ancient castle walls, mystical woodlands, faerie spaces, wandering spirits, and curious ravens. Get a tarot reading, gather for a séance, try the spirit board, wander enchanted forests, encounter woodland and mystical creatures, and uncover hidden magical spaces throughout the grounds. Explore witchcraft, faerie lore, enchanted arts, and more at this destination, which is the official fundraising arm of the Charge Syndrome Foundation.

title: The Wylde
desc: Welcome to The Wylde. Be gentle, be kind, find peace. Come wander the forest trails, dance in the grassy meadow. Find comfy places to sit and relax, to cuddle, to chat with friends. Explore the watchtower and the observatory. Search for the magical cavern and the hidden grotto.

title: Svarga
desc: Climb on top of a giant wasp and take a guided tour of this tropical island, which first opened in 2006. Explore the library inside the central tower, relax near the spring fountain, or start an impromptu jam session with some peculiar elven instruments inside the playhouse.

title: Once upon a time
desc: Once upon a time is a playful, photogenic region that captures the inner child in you. You can explore, touch, play, jump, ride, and more! But remember to click everything, as there are many hidden fun items throughout. Think big, but most importantly, enjoy the small things.

title: Majilis Al Jinn
desc: Majilis Al Jinn is an Arabian fantasy region inspired in part by the Arabian Nights tales, movies and literature. Welcome to an ancient land of burning sun, dry sand, verdant oases and ancient tombs.

title: Kingdom of Alurel
desc: Alurel is a residential, fantasy-themed estate and everyone is welcome to wander the regions. Bring a friend and dance, look for surprises, find quiet places to meditate, take a boat out on the lake, and explore! It is newcomer friendly and perfect for relaxing.

title: Folkvang
desc: Visit the beautiful Norse-themed Folkvang, home to Goddess Freja and her Valkyries. Her land is filled with wonders to explore. Visit castle Sessrumnir and explore Norse and Viking age history. Take tours of the inviting areas filled with Viking-themed settlements. Find gates to hidden worlds, take on a challenging quest to recover Freja's beloved jewel Brísingamen, or take a Viking ship ride to England.

title: Fantasy Community Center
desc: This public community center is for the Bellisseria Fantasy Homes regions. Surrounded by lush landscaping, this masterpiece of design is a feast for the eyes.

title: Cerridwen's Cauldron
desc: Cerridwen´s Cauldron has been a top Fantasy and Sci-Fi Landscaping brand for over 17 years, and their new region is much more than just a store. It's an experience, a temple, a sanctuary, and a realm for you to explore. Visit Caer Awen, the Citadel of Inspiration, a full region build that mixes styles seamlessly into a unique experience. And coming soon, a ground level to match!
